repos.description: Open-source Windows and Office activator featuring HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS activation methods, along with advanced troubleshooting.
repos.summary_zh: MAS 是一个开源的 Windows 和 Office 激活工具，支持 HWID、Ohook、TSforge 和在线 KMS 等多种激活方式，并提供高级故障排除功能。通过 PowerShell 脚本或传统 CMD 文件一键激活系统，适用于 Windows 8.1/10/11 及 Office 产品，集成自动化与跨平台支持。
repos.summary_en: MAS is an open-source activator for Windows and Office using HWID, Ohook, TSforge, and Online KMS methods, with advanced troubleshooting. It enables one-click activation via PowerShell or CMD scripts, supporting Windows 8.1/10/11 and Office, featuring automation and cross-platform compatibility.

repos.description: A modern GUI client based on Tauri, designed to run in Windows, macOS and Linux for tailored proxy experience
repos.summary_zh: Clash Verge Rev 是基于 Tauri 2 和 Rust 构建的现代化 Clash.Meta 客户端，支持跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux），提供简洁美观的 GUI 界面、配置文件管理、TUN 模式、WebDav 同步及自定义主题，适用于高性能代理需求。
repos.summary_en: Clash Verge Rev is a modern GUI client for Clash.Meta (mihomo) built with Tauri 2 and Rust, offering cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux), intuitive UI, config management, TUN mode, WebDav sync, and customizable themes for advanced proxy control.

repos.description: A GUI client for Windows, Linux and macOS, support Xray and sing-box and others
repos.summary_zh: v2rayN 是一款基于 .NET 的跨平台 GUI 代理客户端，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 系统。它集成了 Xray、sing-box 等多种核心，提供简洁易用的界面来管理复杂的网络代理配置，并支持 GPG 签名校验以确保软件分发安全。
repos.summary_en: v2rayN is a cross-platform GUI proxy client built on .NET, supporting Windows, Linux, and macOS. It integrates multiple cores like Xray and sing-box, offering a user-friendly interface to manage complex network proxy configurations, with GPG signature verification for secure software distribution.

repos.description: :atom: The hackable text editor
repos.summary_zh: Atom 是一款基于 Electron 构建的现代化可定制文本编辑器，专为 21 世纪开发者设计。它融合了经典编辑器的优点，支持深度自定义但默认配置友好易用，适用于跨平台开发环境。
repos.summary_en: Atom is a hackable, modern text editor built on Electron, designed for deep customization while remaining approachable. It combines the best features of traditional editors with a flexible, open-source architecture for developers.

repos.description: ☄🌌️  The minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable prompt for any shell!
repos.summary_zh: Starship 是一款极简、极速且高度可定制的跨平台命令行提示符工具，支持任意 Shell（如 Bash、Zsh、Fish、PowerShell 等）。它通过 Rust 编写，性能卓越，能智能显示 Git 状态、编程语言版本、环境变量等上下文信息，极大提升终端使用效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: Starship is a minimal, blazing-fast, and infinitely customizable cross-shell prompt written in Rust. It intelligently displays contextual information like Git status, language versions, and environment variables across any shell (Bash, Zsh, Fish, PowerShell, etc.), enhancing terminal productivity and aesthetics.

repos.description: A full-featured download manager.
repos.summary_zh: Motrix 是一款现代化全功能下载管理器，支持 HTTP、FTP、BitTorrent 及磁力链接。v2 基于 Electron+React+TypeScript 重构，采用 MDXP 协议实现浏览器扩展与 CLI 远程控制，支持 Docker 无头服务器部署，适用于桌面与 NAS/家庭服务器场景。
repos.summary_en: Motrix is a modern, full-featured download manager supporting HTTP, FTP, BitTorrent, and magnet links. v2 is rebuilt with Electron, React, and TypeScript, using the MDXP protocol for browser extensions and CLI remote control. It supports Docker headless deployment, ideal for desktop and NAS/home server scenarios.

repos.description: Create polished demo videos without editing skills. Mac/Windows/Linux
repos.summary_zh: Recordly 是一款开源的跨平台屏幕录制与编辑工具，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux。它无需后期剪辑即可生成专业级演示视频，内置自动缩放、光标美化、动态摄像头气泡叠加、时间轴编辑及扩展市场等功能，专为教程、产品演示等场景优化，显著提升录制效率与视觉表现。
repos.summary_en: Recordly is an open-source, cross-platform screen recorder and editor for macOS, Windows, and Linux. It enables polished screen recordings without post-editing by offering auto-zooms, cursor enhancements, dynamic webcam overlays, timeline editing, and a community extension marketplace—ideal for demos, walkthroughs, and product videos.

repos.description: Privacy first, AI meeting assistant with 4x faster Parakeet/Whisper live transcription, speaker diarization, and Ollama summarization built on Rust. 100% local processing. no cloud required. Meetily (Meetly Ai - https://meetily.ai) is the #1 Self-hosted, Open-source Ai meeting note taker for macOS & Windows. Understand How to write meeting minutes
repos.summary_zh: Meetily 是一款基于 Rust 构建的隐私优先 AI 会议助手，支持 macOS 和 Windows 平台。它利用本地 AI 模型（如 Ollama）实现 4 倍速的实时转录、说话人分离及会议摘要，所有数据均在本地处理，无需云端，完美契合企业对数据主权与合规性的严苛要求。
repos.summary_en: Meetily is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant built on Rust for macOS and Windows. Leveraging local AI models like Ollama, it delivers 4x faster real-time transcription, speaker diarization, and summarization with 100% local processing, ensuring complete data sovereignty and compliance without cloud dependency.

repos.description: 🦄️ 🎃 👻 Clash Premium 规则集(RULE-SET)，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等基于 Clash Premium 内核的客户端。
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供专为 Clash Premium 内核设计的规则集（RULE-SET），涵盖直连、代理和广告拦截域名列表，兼容 ClashX Pro、Clash for Windows 等主流客户端。规则数据源自 v2ray-rules-dat、domain-list-community 等权威源，每日自动更新，支持中国大陆 IP 地址识别，适用于科学上网与网络流量精细化管控。
repos.summary_en: This project provides rule sets (RULE-SET) specifically designed for Clash Premium kernel, including direct, proxy, and ad-blocking domain lists. Compatible with ClashX Pro, Clash for Windows, and other GUI clients. Data sources include v2ray-rules-dat and domain-list-community, with daily automatic updates and support for China IP address recognition, ideal for network traffic control and bypassing restrictions.

repos.description: Lovely console emulator package for Windows
repos.summary_zh: Cmder 是一款专为 Windows 设计的轻量级终端模拟器，基于 ConEmu 深度优化，集成 Monokai 配色、clink 增强命令行及自定义提示符。其核心优势在于完全便携性，无外部依赖，支持 USB 存储或云同步，内置 wget、curl、git 等工具，适合开发者随时随地高效使用命令行环境。
repos.summary_en: Cmder is a portable console emulator for Windows, built on ConEmu with major enhancements including Monokai color scheme, clink integration, and customizable prompts. It offers zero external dependencies, ideal for USB drives or cloud storage, and includes tools like wget, curl, and git for seamless command-line productivity.

repos.description: Bring macOS “Quick Look” feature to Windows
repos.summary_zh: QuickLook 是一款为 Windows 系统移植的 macOS ‘快速查看’ 功能工具，支持通过空格键即时预览文件内容，涵盖图片、文档、视频等多种格式。其核心优势在于轻量化设计、低资源占用和高度可扩展性，用户可通过插件系统自定义预览功能，极大提升文件浏览效率。
repos.summary_en: QuickLook brings macOS 'Quick Look' functionality to Windows, enabling instant file previews by pressing the spacebar. It supports diverse file types including images, documents, and videos with minimal resource usage and extensibility via plugins, significantly enhancing file browsing efficiency.

repos.description: 🐱 BongoCat — A cross-platform interactive desktop pet that brings fun to your desktop!
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat 是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，基于 Tauri 框架开发，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 系统。它以可爱的猫咪形象提供桌面陪伴功能，用户可通过点击、拖拽等交互触发趣味动画，为日常办公增添轻松娱乐元素。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet built with Tauri, supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a playful cat character that responds to user interactions like clicks and drags with animated effects, adding entertainment to your desktop experience.

repos.description: 🐱 🧸跨平台互动桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
repos.summary_zh: BongoCat是一款跨平台互动桌宠应用，支持Windows、macOS和Linux。猫咪会在桌面上自由行走、互动，为桌面增添趣味与陪伴感。项目正从Tauri迁移至C/C++、SDL3和OpenGL的原生实现，轻量高效，适合个性化桌面装饰与解压场景。
repos.summary_en: BongoCat is a cross-platform interactive desktop pet app supporting Windows, macOS, and Linux. The cat wanders and interacts on your desktop, adding fun and companionship. Migrating from Tauri to a native C/C++ + SDL3 + OpenGL implementation for better performance, ideal for desktop personalization and stress relief.

repos.description: An open-source, AI-integrated, cross-platform terminal for seamless workflows
repos.summary_zh: Wave Terminal 是一款开源、集成 AI 的智能跨平台终端，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它兼容任意 AI 模型（如 OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），支持本地运行 Ollama 等模型，无需账户即可使用。核心特性包括：持久化 SSH 会话、内嵌远程文件编辑器、富文本预览（Markdown/图片/PDF）、AI 助手实时分析终端输出并操作文件，以及强大的 `wsh` CLI 工具实现工作区管理与跨会话数据同步。
repos.summary_en: Wave Terminal is an open-source, AI-integrated terminal for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It supports any AI model via BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) for OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or local models like Ollama/LM Studio. Key features include durable SSH sessions with auto-reconnect, built-in remote file editor, rich file previews (markdown, images, PDFs), context-aware Wave AI assistant that analyzes terminal output and performs file operations, and a powerful `wsh` CLI system for workspace management and cross-session data sync.

repos.description: Orchestrate multiple coding agents from desktop and mobile
repos.summary_zh: Paseo 是一个跨平台编程代理编排工具，支持通过手机、桌面端和 CLI 远程管理 Claude Code、Codex 和 OpenCode 等 AI 编码助手。核心特性包括本地自托管运行、多模型统一接口、语音控制、跨设备同步以及零追踪的隐私保护。用户可在任意终端启动任务，实现从构思到部署的无缝协作。
repos.summary_en: Paseo is a cross-platform orchestration tool for coding agents, enabling remote management of Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode via phone, desktop, or CLI. Key features include self-hosted local execution, unified multi-provider interface, voice control, device synchronization, and privacy-first design with no telemetry. It allows seamless task delegation and hands-off automation across environments.

repos.description: 🌈一个跨平台的划词翻译和OCR软件 | A cross-platform software for text translation and recognition.
repos.summary_zh: Pot 是一款跨平台划词翻译与 OCR 软件，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 及 Wayland 环境，集成 OpenAI、Google、DeepL 等 20+ 翻译接口，提供多接口并行翻译、语音合成、生词本导出等功能，具备插件系统和外部调用能力，界面简洁高效。
repos.summary_en: Pot is a cross-platform software for text translation and OCR, supporting Windows/macOS/Linux and Wayland. It integrates 20+ translation APIs including OpenAI, Google, and DeepL, offering parallel translation, speech synthesis, vocabulary export, plugin system, and external call functionality with a clean interface.

repos.description: This repository is outdated and new Boost Note app is available! We've launched a new Boost Note app which supports real-time collaborative writing. https://github.com/BoostIO/BoostNote-App
repos.summary_zh: BoostNote-Legacy 是一款面向程序员的开源笔记应用，支持多平台（Mac、Windows、Linux）。该仓库已标记为过时，推荐使用支持实时协作的新版 BoostNote 应用，其基于 Electron、React + Redux 构建，提供跨平台桌面与移动端支持。
repos.summary_en: BoostNote-Legacy is an open-source note-taking app designed for programmers, supporting Mac, Windows, and Linux. This repository is deprecated; users are advised to migrate to the new BoostNote app, which features real-time collaborative writing and is built with Electron, React + Redux.

repos.description: :octocat: A collection of APIs
repos.summary_zh: Awesome APIs 是一个精选的 API 集合库，涵盖动漫、博客、书籍、商业、日历、云服务等 40+ 领域，为开发者提供丰富的第三方接口资源，支持快速集成各类功能，提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Awesome APIs is a curated collection of over 40 categories of developer-friendly APIs, including anime, blogging, books, business, cloud services, and more, enabling rapid integration of diverse functionalities and enhancing development efficiency.

repos.description: [deprecated in favor of https://microsoft.github.io/react-native-windows/] React Native for macOS is an experimental fork for writing desktop apps using Cocoa
repos.summary_zh: React Native macOS 是一个实验性分支，允许使用 React Native 和 Cocoa 构建 macOS 桌面应用。该项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至微软官方支持的 React Native Windows 或利用 Catalyst 技术运行。
repos.summary_en: React Native for macOS was an experimental fork enabling desktop app development using React Native and Cocoa. The project is now deprecated and no longer maintained, with Microsoft's React Native Windows recommended as the successor.

repos.description: ✍️ A static blog writing client (一个静态博客写作客户端)
repos.summary_zh: Gridea 是一款跨平台静态博客写作客户端，支持 Markdown 编辑、多语言界面、主题定制及 Gitalk/DisqusJS 评论系统。用户可本地创作并一键发布至 GitHub Pages 等平台，集成 OneDrive/iCloud 实现多设备同步，适合个人知识管理与内容创作。
repos.summary_en: Gridea is a cross-platform static blog writing client that supports Markdown editing, multi-language interface, theme customization, and Gitalk/DisqusJS comment systems. It enables local content creation with one-click publishing to platforms like GitHub Pages, featuring OneDrive/iCloud sync for multi-device workflows, ideal for personal knowledge management and content creation.

repos.description: A ready-to-go translation ocr tool developed with WPF/WPF 开发的一款即用即走的翻译、OCR工具
repos.summary_zh: STranslate 是一款基于 WPF 开发的即用即走翻译与 OCR 工具，支持多语言实时翻译与屏幕文字识别，具备轻量化、跨平台特性，提供简洁高效的用户界面，适用于办公、学习等场景的文本快速处理需求。
repos.summary_en: STranslate is a ready-to-use translation and OCR tool built with WPF, offering real-time multilingual translation and screen text recognition. It features a lightweight, cross-platform design with an intuitive interface, ideal for quick text processing in work and study environments.

repos.description: Windows版本微信客户端（非网页版）自动化，可实现简单的发送、接收微信消息，简单微信机器人
repos.summary_zh: wxauto 是一个基于 Windows 平台、使用 UIAutomation 技术实现的微信客户端自动化工具，支持消息发送与接收，适用于开发简单微信机器人的场景。项目于2025年10月28日停止维护，仅支持微信3.9.x版本及Windows 10/11或Server 2016+系统。
repos.summary_en: wxauto is a Windows-based automation tool for the WeChat desktop client (non-web version) using UIAutomation technology. It enables basic message sending and receiving, suitable for building simple WeChat bots. The project was discontinued on October 28, 2025, supporting WeChat 3.9.x and Windows 10/11 or Server 2016+. It is intended solely for technical learning and not for production or illegal use.

repos.description: "Sigma File Manager" is a free, open-source, quickly evolving, modern file manager (explorer / browser) app for Windows and Linux.
repos.summary_zh: Sigma File Manager 是一款免费开源的现代文件管理器，专为 Windows 和 Linux 设计，支持快速文件浏览与操作。项目已进入 v2 稳定测试阶段，提供直观界面与高效功能，适用于日常文件管理需求。
repos.summary_en: Sigma File Manager is a free, open-source, modern file manager for Windows and Linux, offering fast file browsing and operations. Now in v2 beta, it features an intuitive interface and efficient tools for streamlined file management.

repos.description: One Remote Access Manager to Rule Them All
repos.summary_zh: 1Remote 是一款现代化的个人远程会话管理与启动工具，支持 RDP、SSH、VNC、Telnet、(S)FTP 等多种协议，提供多屏幕 HiDPI 连接、标签化界面、自定义运行器及 mRemoteNG 导入功能，支持便携运行与多语言主题定制。
repos.summary_en: 1Remote is a modern personal remote session manager and launcher supporting RDP, SSH, VNC, Telnet, (S)FTP, RemoteApp, NoMachine and more. It offers multi-screen HiDPI RDP support, customizable runners, mRemoteNG import, portable deployment, and a tabbed, multi-language interface.

repos.description: Record your screen, ship a demo. Free and open-source, GPU-accelerated, no watermarks, no subscriptions. Windows, macOS, Linux. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: OpenScreen 是一款免费开源的屏幕录制与演示制作工具，作为 Screen Studio 的开源替代方案。支持窗口/全屏录制、自动缩放、光标特效、摄像头画中画、本地 AI 字幕生成及 AI 编辑助手，适用于产品演示、教程视频和社交媒体内容创作，支持 macOS/Windows/Linux 跨平台使用。
repos.summary_en: OpenScreen is a free, open-source screen recording and demo creation tool, positioned as an alternative to Screen Studio. It features window/full-screen recording, auto-zooms, cursor effects, webcam overlay, on-device AI captions, and an AI editing assistant. Ideal for product demos, tutorials, and social media content across macOS, Windows, and Linux.

repos.description: Hold a key, speak, release — AI-polished text appears at your cursor in any app. Open-source voice input for macOS & Windows. (按住快捷键说话，松开即得润色后的文字)
repos.summary_zh: OpenLess 是一款开源的跨平台语音输入工具，支持 macOS 和 Windows。用户按住快捷键说话，松开后即可获得 AI 润色后的文本，并自动插入光标位置或复制到剪贴板。其核心亮点是 AI 提示模式，能将口语化表达转化为结构清晰、上下文丰富的提示词，适用于 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具，提升输入效率。
repos.summary_en: OpenLess is an open-source, cross-platform voice input app for macOS and Windows. Press a hotkey, speak naturally, and get AI-polished text inserted at your cursor or copied to clipboard. Its standout feature is AI-prompt mode, which transforms rambling speech into structured, context-rich prompts ready for use in ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools.

repos.description: 一个基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 + Durable Objects 的免费多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时监控、离线告警，到期通知，历史数据查看、延迟追踪、地图展示等功能。兼容主流Linux系统，Alpine Linux，OpenWrt，macOS，群晖 DSM、飞牛 fnOS、Windows系统。
repos.summary_zh: CF-Server-Monitor 是一款基于 Cloudflare Workers + D1 的多服务器监控探针系统，支持实时追踪 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络等指标，提供历史图表、全球地图展示、离线告警及 WebSocket 实时推送。兼容 Linux、Alpine、OpenWrt 和 Windows 系统，集成 JWT 认证与 Turnstile 人机验证，通过 GitHub Actions 实现一键部署，适合运维自动化与多节点监控场景。
repos.summary_en: CF-Server-Monitor is a multi-server monitoring probe system built on Cloudflare Workers and D1, offering real-time tracking of CPU, memory, disk, and network metrics with historical charts, global map visualization, offline alerts, and WebSocket-based live updates. Compatible with Linux, Alpine, OpenWrt, and Windows, it integrates JWT authentication and Turnflare Turnstile verification, enabling one-click deployment via GitHub Actions for efficient operations automation and multi-node monitoring.

repos.description: Simple and complete web UI framework to create web apps with Windows 8 Metro user interface, based on Bootstrap 2.
repos.summary_zh: BootMetro 是一个基于 Bootstrap 2 的 Web UI 框架，专为创建具有 Windows 8 Metro 风格界面的应用而设计，无需依赖 Windows 8 系统。它整合了 HTML5 Boilerplate 和 IcoMoon 图标库，提供 Metro 风格的布局、磁贴、通知、列表视图和翻转视图等组件，适用于企业内部网等现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: BootMetro is a web UI framework built on Bootstrap 2, designed to create web apps with the Windows 8 MetroUI style without requiring Windows 8. It integrates HTML5 Boilerplate and IcoMoon icons, offering Metro-styled layouts, tiles, toasts, list views, and flip views, ideal for modern intranet applications.

repos.description: ClawGod is a runtime patch applied to the official Claude Code. It continues to be supported with each version update.
repos.summary_zh: ClawGod 是一个专为 Claude Code 设计的运行时补丁工具，通过动态注入方式解锁官方版本限制的功能，包括隐藏命令、多智能体协作、屏幕控制等。支持跨平台自动更新与卸载，绿色图标标识已打补丁状态，显著提升开发效率与功能自由度。
repos.summary_en: ClawGod is a runtime patch for Claude Code that unlocks restricted features like hidden commands, multi-agent collaboration, and computer use without Pro subscription. It auto-reapplies patches after updates, uses green branding to indicate patched status, and supports cross-platform installation with one-line scripts.

repos.description: Authenticator on Windows for Battle.net / Steam / Guild Wars 2 / Glyph / Runescape / SWTOR / Bitcoin and digital currency exchanges
repos.summary_zh: WinAuth 是一款开源的 Windows 多平台双因子认证工具，支持 RFC 6238 时间型（TOTP）和 HOTP 计数器型验证码，兼容 Battle.net、Steam、Guild Wars 2、SWTOR 及主流数字货币交易所。具备密码保护、机器绑定、YubiKey 支持、热键操作、便携模式及跨设备导入导出功能，适用于安全与便捷的双重认证管理。
repos.summary_en: WinAuth is an open-source, portable authenticator for Windows that supports RFC 6238 (TOTP) and HOTP-based 2FA codes. It integrates authenticators for Battle.net, Steam, Guild Wars 2, SWTOR, and major cryptocurrency exchanges like Coinbase and Bitstamp. Features include password protection, machine binding, YubiKey support, hotkey controls, portable mode, and import/export via UriKeyFormat, enabling secure and unified two-factor authentication management.

repos.description: 高颜值的第三方网易云播放器；通过自写插件可支持其他线上音乐服务；支持流媒体音乐，如navidrome、jellyfin、emby；支持本地音乐播放、离线歌单、逐字歌词、桌面歌词、Touch Bar歌词、Mac状态栏歌词显示、Linux-gnome与Linux-kde桌面状态栏歌词显示；支持降调降速，支持自定义主题等。支持 Windows / macOS / Linux :electron:
repos.summary_zh: VutronMusic 是一款高颜值跨平台第三方网易云音乐播放器，支持本地音乐、流媒体服务（如Navidrome、Jellyfin）、离线歌单及逐字歌词。具备桌面歌词、状态栏歌词、变调变速、自定义主题等功能，采用 Vue3 + TypeScript + Fastify 架构，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台。
repos.summary_en: VutronMusic is a high-end third-party NetEase Cloud Music player supporting local music, streaming services (Navidrome, Jellyfin), offline playlists, and karaoke-style lyrics. Features include desktop lyrics, system tray display, pitch/speed control, custom themes, and advanced audio effects. Built with Vue3, TypeScript, Fastify, and Electron for cross-platform support.

repos.description: Modern mouse gestures for Windows. (C#)
repos.summary_zh: WGestures 是一款现代化的 Windows 全局鼠标手势工具，支持 Win7/8/10，提供直观的手势操作以提升效率。采用 C# 开发，集成数字签名与安装程序，适用于快速执行系统命令或应用操作。
repos.summary_en: WGestures is a modern global mouse gesture tool for Windows (Win7/8/10), enabling efficient navigation via intuitive gestures. Built in C# with digital signing and MSI installer support, it streamlines workflow automation through customizable gesture actions.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款开源免费的 macOS 原生系统管理工具，集垃圾清理、应用卸载、磁盘分析、重复文件查找和实时状态监控于一体。内置 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 代理安全可控地监控和维护 Mac，所有操作可审计、可回滚。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS system management tool that combines junk cleanup, app uninstallation, disk analysis, duplicate finding, and live status monitoring. It features a built-in MCP server for AI agents like Claude Code and Cursor to safely monitor and maintain your Mac, with all actions consent-gated, audited, and reversible.

repos.description: Power Keys - 解放 Windows 和 macOS 使用效率
repos.summary_zh: Power Keys 是一款专为 Windows 和 macOS 设计的效率工具，通过精心设计的无冲突快捷键组合，显著提升系统操作效率。其核心价值在于统一跨平台快捷键逻辑，降低学习成本，适用于日常办公、开发及多任务处理场景。
repos.summary_en: Power Keys is an efficiency tool for Windows and macOS that boosts productivity through well-designed, non-conflicting keyboard shortcuts. It unifies cross-platform shortcut logic, reducing learning curves for developers and power users in daily workflows and multitasking.

repos.description: A free, elegant Markdown editor for macOS, Windows and Linux. Simple by design, always in sync with the file on disk.
repos.summary_zh: ColaMD 是一款专为 AI 智能体协作设计的原生 Markdown 编辑器，支持实时同步 AI 对 .md 文件的修改，具备 WYSIWYG 编辑、多主题支持和跨平台导出功能。其核心亮点在于通过文件监听实现 AI 操作的无缝可视化，让用户像结对编程一样观察智能体工作过程。
repos.summary_en: ColaMD is an Agent-Native Markdown editor designed for real-time collaboration between humans and AI agents. It instantly reflects AI-generated changes to .md files via file system monitoring, featuring WYSIWYG editing, cross-platform support, and theme customization—eliminating manual refresh cycles during agent-assisted writing.

repos.description: 🐹 Cleanup, app management, maintenance, disk analysis, and live status in one free, open-source, native Mac app + extensive support for AI agents. Coming to Windows
repos.summary_zh: Burrow 是一款免费开源的原生 macOS GUI 工具，为 Mole CLI 提供可视化操作界面。它集成了磁盘清理、应用卸载、系统优化、磁盘分析及实时状态监控功能，并支持长期历史记录与本地 MCP 服务器，方便 AI 智能体通过自然语言直接操控系统维护任务，即将支持 Windows 平台。
repos.summary_en: Burrow is a free, open-source native macOS GUI for the Mole CLI engine. It bundles disk cleaning, app uninstallation, system optimization, disk analysis, and live status monitoring. Featuring long-range history and a local MCP server, it enables AI agents to autonomously diagnose and resolve system issues via natural language, with a Windows version in preview.

repos.description: Open-source cross-platform software KVM for sharing keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux on trusted LANs.
repos.summary_zh: MyKVM 是一款开源的跨平台软件 KVM 解决方案，允许用户通过局域网在 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 设备间无缝共享键盘、鼠标和剪贴板。它利用 QUIC/TLS 加密传输输入与剪贴板数据，支持自动发现与多显示器布局，旨在替代传统硬件 KVM 切换器，为多机工作者提供零线缆的流畅体验。
repos.summary_en: MyKVM is an open-source, cross-platform software KVM that enables seamless sharing of keyboard, mouse, and clipboard across Windows, macOS, and Linux devices over a trusted LAN. Utilizing encrypted QUIC/TLS for input and clipboard data transfer, it features automatic peer discovery and multi-monitor layout support, aiming to replace traditional hardware KVM switches with a zero-cable experience for multi-machine workflows.

repos.description: 使用任何设备(浏览器)作为mac的副屏(随航) 将Android平板用作Mac的第二台显示器 还能在Win和Linux镜像屏幕
repos.summary_zh: 咩Display 是一款跨平台屏幕镜像工具，支持将任意带浏览器的设备（如 Android 平板）作为 Mac 的副屏，实现类似 Apple 随航的功能。基于 ffmpeg 实时转码，支持 mjpg、vp8、h264、hevc 多种编码，延迟低至 100ms（mjpg 模式），适用于 Windows/Linux 屏幕镜像。内置自动旋转、全屏切换，支持通过 ADB 实现 Android 有线连接，适合多屏办公与移动场景。
repos.summary_en: meDisplay is a cross-platform screen mirroring tool that turns any browser-equipped device (e.g., Android tablet) into a secondary display for Mac, mimicking Apple's Sidecar. Built with real-time ffmpeg transcoding, it supports mjpg, vp8, h264, and hevc encoding with ultra-low latency (as low as 100ms in mjpg mode). Also supports Windows/Linux X11 mirroring, auto-rotation, fullscreen toggle, and ADB-based Android wired connection for seamless multi-screen workflows.

repos.description: 让 Codex、Claude Code 等 AI Agent 成为你的跨平台电脑维修助手：64 个按需加载的 Playbook，覆盖诊断、清理、性能、网络与安全维护——C 盘爆满、电脑卡顿、流氓软件、应用迁移、数据恢复都能直接问；先取证、再计划，确认后修改。
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个面向AI Agent的跨平台电脑维修Skill，提供64个按需加载的Playbook，覆盖Windows/macOS/Linux的诊断、清理、性能优化、网络与安全维护。采用
repos.summary_en: A cross-platform computer repair Skill for AI Agents, featuring 64 on-demand Playbooks covering Windows, macOS, and Linux diagnostics, cleanup, performance optimization, and security maintenance. Follows an evidence-first, plan-confirm-modify workflow for natural language-based PC troubleshooting.

repos.description: Local-first Windows WeChat memory archive with traceable PDF, Markdown, and JSON exports｜本地优先的微信个人记忆库
repos.summary_zh: 微信 AI 记忆库是一款本地优先的桌面工具，直接从 Windows 微信 4.x 读取聊天记录，支持按会话、日期和关键词筛选，可导出 PDF、Markdown 与结构化 JSON。全程仅操作临时数据库副本，图片恢复、语音转写（faster-whisper）均在本机完成，无任何数据上传。
repos.summary_en: WeChat AI Memory is a local-first desktop tool that directly reads Windows WeChat 4.x chat data, supports filtering by conversation, date, and keywords, and exports to PDF, Markdown, and structured JSON. All operations—including image recovery and voice transcription via faster-whisper—stay on-device with zero data uploads.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频（使用自己的APIKEY），编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 提示词的 AI 语音输入工具，支持多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，实现专有词汇、术语、人名及数字格式的一次性精准转录，内置 AI 图像文字提取功能，可智能修复断行与还原代码结构，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台，用户自备 API Key，数据直连服务商，安全高效。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is an AI-powered voice input tool driven by Markdown prompts, using multimodal LLMs to process raw audio directly for accurate transcription of names, jargon, and formatting in one pass. It includes AI-based text extraction from images, intelligently restoring broken lines and code structure. Supports macOS, Windows, and iOS with user-provided API keys for secure, direct cloud processing.

repos.description: Full-featured GUI for Claude Code CLI in VS Code — Windows (no WSL) & macOS. Third-party API, MCP plugins, Skills, Hooks, real-time token tracking. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: ByeType 是一个 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频。编辑 Markdown 文件即可自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略，人名、术语、口水词、数字格式一次转录到位，减少二次修改。支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS。
repos.summary_zh: ByeType 是一款基于 Markdown 驱动的 AI 语音输入工具，利用多模态大模型直接处理原始音频，支持自定义专有词汇、转录规则和格式化策略。通过编辑 Markdown 提示词，实现人名、术语、数字格式等一次性精准转写，减少二次修改，支持 macOS、Windows 和 iOS 平台。
repos.summary_en: ByeType is a Markdown-driven AI voice input tool that uses multimodal large models to directly process raw audio. It supports custom vocabulary, transcription rules, and formatting strategies via editable Markdown prompts. Achieving accurate, one-time transcription of names, terms, and numbers without post-processing, it runs on macOS, Windows, and iOS.

repos.description: A Flask-based tool that types or copies text from mobile devices directly to Windows computers.
repos.summary_zh: EasyType 是一款基于 Flask 的跨平台输入工具，支持手机实时输入内容并直接推送到 Windows 剪贴板或模拟键盘输入，具备低延迟同步、移动端优化界面和多种快捷键支持，适用于远程办公与高效输入场景。
repos.summary_en: EasyType is a Flask-based tool enabling real-time text input from mobile devices to Windows via clipboard or direct keyboard simulation, featuring low-latency sync, mobile-optimized UI, and shortcut support for remote typing and clipboard sharing.
